author: TrustyJAID
description: Pin the messages a server thinks are worth keeping. React with a starboard's emoji and, once enough people have, the message is posted to that starboard's channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the IDs of messages that have been starred, the IDs of the people who starred them, and the IDs of roles and channels a server has allowed or blocked. Everything it stores comes from reacting to a message or from a server's own settings.
install_msg: Set your starboards up on the dashboard. `/starboard star`, `/starboard unstar` and `/starboard info` are the commands.
name: Starboard
short: Keep the messages a server likes best.
